svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end B3 + F4. The lower voice moves from C4 to B3, down 1 semitone. The upper voice moves from E4 to F4, up 1 semitone. The new pair B3 + F4 spans 5 letters and 6 semitones: a diminished fifth, in the tritone colour #5366A0, Plogger bracket [6] (straight contour, shadow on both sides, midtone dotted fill).
svg.title: Change 4: moving apart, B3 and F4, a diminished fifth

g.text: How to read this graphic: The arrows above the keys show the two voices leaving C4 and
E4 in opposite directions. The keys B3 and F4 are tinted with the tritone colour, and
the six numbered arcs count every key from B3 to F4. The chip is a separate historic
lens, not the colour. These are B3 and F4, not the C4 and F♯4 on the Palette card.
